newsitem.title: USA: Bill to abolish U.S. Energy Department proposed.
newsitem.headline: Bill to abolish U.S. Energy Department proposed.

text.p: U.S. Senator Rod Grams said Tuesday he would introduce legislation on Wednesday to abolish the U.S. Energy Department.

Grams, a Minnesota Republican, is a member of the Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee. The committee is scheduled to hold a confirmation hearing Thursday on President Clinton's nomination of Federico Pena to be Energy Secretary. Grams is expected to question Pena on the usefulness of the department.
